verdict.rationale: Dagster+ has a published pricing page listing tiers (e.g., a $10/month Solo plan), giving a starting point for cost estimation, but the evidence never explains how pricing scales with additional data sources/connectors (compute credits, usage-based charges, etc.), so a platform lead cannot concretely estimate the incremental cost of connecting a new source. missing for 10: per-source/connector cost breakdown, usage-based credit pricing details, examples of cost impact when adding integrations like Fivetran/Airbyte/dbt.
